---
title: "ArkModelZoo.jl Vignettes"
---

## Overview

ArkModelZoo.jl contains **154** agent-based models ported from NetLogo to Julia using the [Ark.jl](https://github.com/sdwfrost/Ark.jl) Entity Component System (ECS) framework. Each vignette provides background information, default parameters, time-series plots, ensemble runs, and parameter sensitivity analysis.
